title: datacenter cabinets walkthrough
content:
Quick field scratchpad from rack walkthrough — notes for Acme Financial private deployment (VPC + on-prem hybrid). Day 2 in the datacenter. Use this to jog memory, share with Ethan/Priya, and drop into the handoff doc later.

Context:
- Customer: Acme Financial (PCI scope). Hybrid: VPC peering to us + on-prem racks in DC-3.
- Goal today: finish physical cable routing for Rack B, validate KMS connectivity from on-prem bastion, finish agent install on node-b[01..04], confirm firewall rules with onsite network ops.

High-level summary (what worked / what didn't):
- KVM access: good. Manual console for node-b02 used to confirm boot.
- node-b03 GPU driver mismatch (see troubleshooting).
- VPC peering route accepted by cloud team, but BGP sessions flapped once during our tests. Ops changed hold timer -> stable.
- HSM: customer says HSM appliance is in locked mode until vendor clears; delayed KMS integration by ~4 hrs.

Physical rack / cabinet notes (cabinet labels are red tags):
- Rack B (cabinet 07): top shelf empty, ideal for 10Gb switch trunk to primary ToR.
- node-b01: U4, node-b02: U5, node-b03: U6, node-b04: U7. Marked with white tape 'RW-ACME-B'.
- Patch panel: fibers 12-18 reserved for inter-rack links; we used 12 for node-b01, 13 for node-b02.
- Cabinet grounding: verified continuity to PDUs with Fluke tester, reading 0.2 ohm.

Network/environment reminders (copy these into the setup checklist):
- On-prem management VLAN: 10.250.10.0/24. Node IPs assigned: .11..14 (node-b01..b04).
- Service VLANs: app 10.250.20.0/24, storage 10.250.30.0/24.
- Required ports outbound to Redwood control plane: TCP 443, 5222 (agent heartbeat), 123 (ntp). Allow to our egress IPs: 34.210.87.120/32 and 35.199.66.0/24.
- Required inbound from bastion for maintenance: SSH 22 (allowed only from vendor jump: 172.31.5.10/32).
- KMS endpoints: customer HSM (10.250.40.5) — currently in lockdown; fallback plan: use cloud KMS with envelope keys until vendor enables.

Commands run (capture for reproducibility):
- agent install (on node): 
  curl -sSL https://downloads.redwood.ai/agent/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- --env=acme-prod --token=REDACTED
- health checks: sudo systemctl status redwood-agent.service && sudo journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200
- GPU driver check: nvidia-smi || sudo dpkg -l | grep nvidia
- network routes: ip route show table 100 && curl -sS https://ifconfig.me || true

Troubleshooting: node-b03 GPU driver mismatch
- Observed: redwood-agent OOM during model load; nvidia-smi returned driver API mismatch.
- Steps taken: rebooted node -> stayed in kernel panic on second boot. Switched to serial console -> dropped into emergency shell.
- Fix applied: chroot and purge old nvidia packages, installed driver 535 (matches container runtime). Commands (on rescue): 
  mount /dev/sda2 /mnt && for i in /dev /dev/pts /proc /sys; do mount --bind $i /mnt$i; done; chroot /mnt bash
  apt-get purge -y 'nvidia-*' && apt-get update && apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-535
- Result: node boots clean, nvidia-smi shows GPUs, agent starts and registers.

Blockers and open items:
- HSM locked by vendor -> blocks KMS integration and FIPS verification. Owner: customer SecOps. ETA: vendor callback EOD. (Jira INFRA-827 linked).
- BGP flap root cause unclear: likely TTL/hold-time mismatch between customer edge and our transit. Follow-up with network: open ticket with DC-NOC.
- Cable labeling inconsistent on neighboring rack; need ticket for DC ops to relabel matching our inventory.

Actionable TODOs (short):
- [ ] Drop keys from cloud-KMS fallback into agent config and mark as temporary (Ava) — due 2026-03-13.
- [ ] Confirm vendor HSM unlock window and schedule final KMS test (Priya).
- [ ] Raise DC relabel ticket (Ethan) with photos attached.
- [ ] Run full load test on node-b[01..04] with quantized model profile (after KMS ok) — include latency capture.
- [ ] Add inbound host allowlist for vendor jump to firewall rules doc (copy to confluence).

Notes for handoff to next shift:
- Best next steps: prioritize HSM unlock; if vendor delays, switch to cloud-KMS fallback and continue testbed validation.
- Keep an eye on node-b03 logs for repeated driver/kernel issues — if signs reappear, revert to snapshot pre-driver change and escalate to release-eng.

Quick links / refs (put in doc later):
- Confluence: PRIVATE-DEPLOY-setup-2026 (walkthrough + diagrams)
- Jira: INFRA-827 (HSM/KMS), DEPLOY-1421 (onprem agent rollout)
- GitHub PR: github.com/redwood-inference/agent/pull/456 (hotfix for better GPU detection)
- Slack: #private-deployments (tag @ethan for DC photos)

Random field notes (stream-of-consciousness):
- Remember to bring orange patch cables next time (we used all spares).
- Customer security badge reader hiccup at 14:13 — might need authz update on their side.
- PDUs showing slightly elevated temps in U6; monitor for 24hrs.

End of notes — copy anything important into the canonical handoff doc and mark completed items.

Signature: Ava M. (on-site)
